name: Zul'Farrak
summary: In northwestern Tanaris, Sandfury trolls hold Zul'Farrak behind guarded gates. Long cut off from their kin, they rely on dark voodoo and an army of the dead.

sections.title: The Withered Remnant
sections.body: Inside Zul'Farrak, Sandfury trolls endure the harsh wastes of Tanaris. Little survives of the city's distant past beyond troll legend. Across the desert, its people are known for their ruthlessness. Their priests dig up their own dead and raise them as a shambling army within the sun-bleached stronghold.

sections.title: Legends of the Sand
sections.body: In Gadgetzan, whispers tell of treasures and terrors behind Zul'Farrak's guarded gates. Troll lore speaks of Sul'thraze the Lasher, a legendary broadsword broken into two blades and hidden somewhere in the city. More troubling are the tales of Sergeant Bly and his band of mercenaries, captured after entering the city. Other rumors tell of Gahz'rilla, an ancient hydra demigod said to sleep in a sacred pool at the city's heart.

faq.q: What tribe of trolls lives here?
faq.answer: The Sandfury tribe holds Zul'Farrak. Across Tanaris, these sand trolls are known for ruthlessness and dark mysticism.

faq.q: Why are there so many zombies and graves inside?
faq.answer: Isolation and desperation have driven Sandfury witch doctors and shadow hunters to necromancy. They raise their fallen kin as undead thralls to strengthen their ranks and wage war across Tanaris.

faq.q: What is the ancient monster sleeping in the city?
faq.answer: Gahz'rilla is the sleeping creature, a colossal hydra demigod. The Sandfury revere it in a deep, sacred pool, and rumors say a ritual instrument can call it forth.

Sul'thraze the Lasher is a legendary blade from ancient troll folklore. It saps the strength and will of those it strikes. Long ago, it was broken into Jang'thraze and Sang'thraze, both rumored to be inside the city.

angles.text: The Sandfury see the Darkspear as weak traitors allied with foreign conquerors. Darkspear elders such as Master Gadrin watch their corrupted desert cousins with grim concern.
Human and dwarven explorers come from Gadgetzan to recover ancient relics or rescue missing mercenaries who vanished into the ruins.
